title: No brand-specific tab navigation for multi-brand dealer
quote: Homepage title: 'McPeek's Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram Dealer | Anaheim, CA' — site operates as a combined CDJR dealer without evidence of brand-specific navigation tabs or separated brand sections
recommendation: Implement brand-specific tabs or navigation sections for each Stellantis brand (Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram) so each brand has its own clearly separated navigation path per STEL-NAV-002 requirements.

title: CPO page misconfigured — shows 'New Jeep SUVs' instead of certified pre-owned inventory
quote: PAGE TITLE MISMATCH: URL is /inventory/used/certified/ but title says 'New Jeep SUVs for Sale'. has_cpo_label: false — 'certified pre-owned' text NOT found on page. Appears the CPO page may be misconfigured or showing wrong content.
recommendation: Fix the CPO landing page so it correctly displays certified pre-owned inventory with proper Stellantis CPO branding. The page at /inventory/used/certified/ must show CPO vehicles — not new Jeep SUVs. Each brand's CPO program standards must be properly represented.

title: No Stellantis CPO branding or certification badges on CPO page
quote: has_cpo_label: false — 'certified pre-owned' text NOT found on page. has_certified_badge: true — word 'certified' appears somewhere.
recommendation: Ensure the CPO page uses official Stellantis Certified Pre-Owned branding, logos, and program details for each applicable brand (Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram). CPO vehicles must carry proper certification badges and program benefit descriptions.

title: Lease disclaimers hidden behind click-to-expand buttons
quote: Homepage has rotating banner carousel with 8 'Show Disclaimer' buttons. All lease disclaimers hidden behind 'Show Disclaimer' click-to-expand.
recommendation: Stellantis requires all advertising to include required disclaimers with proper visibility. Lease offer disclaimers should be immediately visible near their associated offers rather than hidden behind click-to-expand buttons. At minimum, key terms (payment amount, term, due at signing, qualifying conditions) should be visible without user interaction.

title: Lease disclaimers missing residual value and money factor
quote: 2025 Jeep Grand Cherokee L - Stock S1450. 36-month closed-end lease. $399 per month plus tax. Must have current Stellantis 4XE Vehicle in home (Loyalty) $3,999 down payment or trade in equity, does not include tax, title, license, dmv and doc fees, acquisition fees, dealer fees, or first month payment. 10,000 miles per year .25 cents per mile overage. No Security Deposit Required. Expires 4/1/2026
recommendation: Lease disclaimers should include total due at signing amount, residual value or purchase option at lease end, and capitalized cost or money factor to meet Stellantis advertising completeness standards. This applies to all four lease offers on the homepage.

title: Lease disclaimers missing total due at lease signing breakdown
quote: $3,999 down payment or trade in equity, does not include tax, title, license, dmv and doc fees, acquisition fees, dealer fees, or first month payment.
recommendation: Stellantis lease advertising requires a clear total due at signing amount. The disclaimers list a $3,999 down payment but state it excludes first month payment, fees, and taxes — making the actual total due at signing unclear. Provide a single total due at signing figure that includes all required upfront costs.

title: Net Price includes trade assistance deduction — potentially misleading pricing
quote: 'Net Price' includes Trade Assistance deduction which requires trade-in — potentially misleading. Shows MSRP, McPeek Discount, Selling Price, Trade Assistance, Net Price.
recommendation: The advertised 'Net Price' of $44,267 deducts $1,000 in 'Trade Assistance' from the selling price, but this requires a qualifying trade-in. Per Stellantis advertising standards, pricing must not include conditional deductions in the primary advertised price without clear, prominent disclosure. The selling price ($45,267) should be the primary price; trade assistance should be shown separately as a conditional incentive.

title: Used vehicle prices hidden behind lead capture form
quote: Used vehicles show KBB Retail price but NOT a dealer selling price. 'Get Your NO BS Price' requires user interaction (lead capture form) to see actual price. Tagline: 'No Hidden Charges. Transparent. Honest Pricing' — but actual price is hidden behind CTA.
recommendation: Used vehicle listings should display a visible selling price. Hiding the dealer price behind a lead capture form while advertising 'No Hidden Charges' and 'Transparent, Honest Pricing' creates a contradiction and does not meet Stellantis VLP transparency standards. Display a visible selling price or internet price on used vehicle listings.

title: Inconsistent model year reference — 2025 Jeep Grand Cherokee L among 2026 models
quote: Lease offers for: 2025 Jeep Grand Cherokee L, 2026 Jeep Wrangler, 2026 Jeep Gladiator, 2026 Ram 1500
recommendation: Verify that the 2025 Jeep Grand Cherokee L lease offer is still an active Stellantis program. Featuring a prior model year among current 2026 model year offers may cause brand inconsistency. If this is an approved carryover offer, ensure proper model year labeling and that Stellantis still supports co-op on this vehicle.

title: Homepage blends all four CDJR brands without distinct brand experiences
quote: Dealer identity: McPeek's Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram of Anaheim. Lease offers mix Jeep and Ram without brand-specific visual treatment.
recommendation: Stellantis guidelines require each brand section to feel like a standalone brand experience. The homepage intermixes Jeep and Ram offers without brand-specific visual differentiation (color palettes, logos, styling). Consider organizing homepage offers by brand with each brand's respective visual treatment.

title: No evidence of brand-specific color palettes in content areas
quote: Homepage features Jeep and Ram offers without indication of brand-specific color differentiation. Jeep should use green/khaki palette; Ram should use black/silver palette.
recommendation: Apply brand-specific color palettes in their respective content areas: Jeep (green/khaki), Ram (black/silver), Dodge (red/black), Chrysler (silver/blue). Each brand's offers and content sections should visually reflect the correct brand palette.

title: Finance page title references only Jeep and Dodge — excludes Chrysler and Ram
quote: Page title: 'Jeep & Dodge Financing | Local Auto Financing in California'
recommendation: As a Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram dealer, the finance page title should reference all four brands or use the full dealer name. Listing only 'Jeep & Dodge' excludes Chrysler and Ram branding, which may not meet Stellantis brand equity requirements for multi-brand dealers.

title: Non-Stellantis brands (Hyundai) displayed in used inventory without brand separation
quote: Sample used vehicle: Used 2023 Hyundai Venue SEL
recommendation: While used inventory commonly includes non-Stellantis brands, ensure that competing brand vehicles are not featured in CDJR-branded sections. Used inventory displaying non-Stellantis makes (Hyundai) should be in a clearly generic 'pre-owned' section without Stellantis brand-specific visual treatment to avoid brand confusion.

title: Lease offers require Stellantis loyalty qualification — eligibility criteria may be too restrictive
quote: Must have current Stellantis 4XE Vehicle in home (Loyalty) — Grand Cherokee L offer. Must have current Stellantis Vehicle in home (Loyalty) — Wrangler, Gladiator, Ram offers.
recommendation: Verify that the advertised lease payments requiring Stellantis loyalty are consistent with Stellantis DAP advertising standards. If the loyalty discount is included in the headline payment, this should be prominently disclosed as a conditional incentive. The Grand Cherokee L offer specifically requires a '4XE Vehicle in home' which is a narrower qualification than the general Stellantis loyalty on other offers — ensure this distinction is clear to consumers.

title: Net Price includes trade-in deduction — not a valid total selling price
quote: Net Price includes Trade Assistance deduction which requires trade-in. MSRP $46,775, McPeek Discount -$1,508, Selling Price $45,267, Trade Assistance -$1,000, Net Price $44,267
recommendation: The advertised 'Net Price' of $44,267 includes a $1,000 Trade Assistance deduction that requires a trade-in. Under VC §11713.1(e), the advertised price must be the total selling price available to any consumer. Remove the Trade Assistance deduction from the advertised price, or clearly label the $45,267 Selling Price as the primary advertised price and show the Trade Assistance as a separate conditional offer below.

title: Doc fee excluded from advertised price using 'plus' language
quote: Tax, Title, License, $85 doc fee, $30 electronic filing fee are additional.
recommendation: The $85 doc fee is NOT an exempt fee under VC §11713.1(e). Only tax, registration/license, electronic filing fee, and smog transfer/certification fees may be excluded from the advertised price. The doc fee must be included in the total advertised selling price. Remove 'doc fee' from the 'additional' exclusion list and add it into the advertised price.

title: Used vehicles show no dealer selling price — only KBB Retail reference price
quote: Used vehicles show KBB Retail price but NOT a dealer selling price. 'Get Your NO BS Price' requires user interaction (lead capture form) to see actual price. Sample: KBB Retail: $16,938, selling_price_shown: false
recommendation: California law requires that when a price is advertised, it must be the total selling price. Showing only a KBB Retail reference price without a dealer selling price, and hiding the actual price behind a lead capture form ('Get Your NO BS Price'), does not satisfy the requirement to advertise a specific total selling price. Either display the dealer's actual selling price for each used vehicle or remove pricing entirely. The KBB Retail price alone could be construed as the advertised price while not actually being the price the dealer is offering.

title: All lease disclaimers hidden behind click-to-expand buttons — not clear and conspicuous
quote: All lease disclaimers hidden behind 'Show Disclaimer' click-to-expand. Homepage has rotating banner carousel with 8 'Show Disclaimer' buttons.
recommendation: Required lease disclosures (Reg M terms, due-at-signing totals, qualification requirements) are hidden behind click-to-expand 'Show Disclaimer' buttons on the homepage carousel. California law requires disclosures to be 'clear and conspicuous' — not requiring a click to access. Display all required lease disclosures directly on the ad, visible without user interaction. At minimum, the total due at signing, monthly payment, term, mileage limit, and qualification requirements must be visible without clicking.

title: Lease disclaimers missing MSRP/cap cost, total due at signing, APR/money factor, and total of payments
quote: 36-month closed-end lease. $399 per month plus tax. Must have current Stellantis 4XE Vehicle in home (Loyalty) $3,999 down payment or trade in equity, does not include tax, title, license, dmv and doc fees, acquisition fees, dealer fees, or first month payment. 10,000 miles per year .25 cents per mile overage. No Security Deposit Required. Expires 4/1/2026
recommendation: The lease advertisements use trigger terms (monthly payment amount, amount due at signing) but are missing several required Reg M disclosures: (1) total amount due at lease signing (only '$3,999 down payment' is shown, which excludes first month payment, acquisition fee, doc fee, and dealer fees), (2) MSRP or agreed-upon value/capitalized cost, (3) total of periodic payments, (4) whether lessee has purchase option at end of lease and at what price. Add all required Regulation M disclosures to each lease advertisement.

title: Lease due-at-signing total is understated — excludes mandatory fees
quote: $3,999 down payment or trade in equity, does not include tax, title, license, dmv and doc fees, acquisition fees, dealer fees, or first month payment.
recommendation: The '$3,999 down payment' is displayed as the amount due at signing, but the disclosure admits this does NOT include first month payment, acquisition fee, doc fee, or dealer fees — all of which are due at lease signing. Regulation M requires that the TOTAL amount due at lease signing be disclosed and that no partial amount (like a down payment alone) be displayed more prominently than the total. Calculate and disclose the complete total due at signing including: down payment + first month payment + acquisition fee + doc fee + any other dealer fees. This total must be at least as prominent as the '$3,999' figure.

title: Lease offers require Stellantis loyalty but qualification not prominently disclosed
quote: Must have current Stellantis Vehicle in home (Loyalty). Must have current Stellantis 4XE Vehicle in home (Loyalty).
recommendation: All four homepage lease offers require Stellantis vehicle loyalty to qualify for the advertised payment. This is a material qualification that restricts the advertised price/payment to a subset of consumers. The loyalty requirement is buried within the click-to-expand disclaimer text rather than being clearly and conspicuously disclosed alongside the advertised payment. The loyalty qualification must be displayed prominently — ideally directly adjacent to or immediately below the advertised lease payment — so consumers immediately understand this offer is not available to all buyers. One lease even requires a Stellantis 4XE vehicle specifically, which is an even narrower qualification.

title: Trade-in requirement for Net Price not clearly disclosed at point of price display
quote: Net Price includes Trade Assistance deduction which requires trade-in. Trade Assistance: -$1,000, Net Price: $44,267
recommendation: The 'Net Price' of $44,267 includes a $1,000 Trade Assistance deduction that requires a trade-in, but the trade-in requirement is not clearly and conspicuously disclosed at the point of price display. Under VC §11713.1(e), if a price is contingent on a trade-in, this must be clearly disclosed. Either remove the trade-in deduction from the primary advertised price or add a prominent, clear disclosure directly adjacent to the Net Price stating 'Requires trade-in' or 'With qualifying trade-in.'

title: Doc fee ($85) excluded from advertised selling price
quote: Tax, Title, License, $85 doc fee, $30 electronic filing fee are additional.
recommendation: The $85 documentary preparation fee is listed as 'additional' to the advertised price. Under California law, only tax, registration, electronic filing fee, and smog transfer/certification fees may be excluded from the advertised price. Doc fees are dealer charges that MUST be included in the total advertised selling price. Include the $85 doc fee in the advertised price and remove it from the exclusion list. Note: the $30 electronic filing fee IS properly excludable.

title: Lease disclaimers exclude doc fees and dealer fees from due-at-signing — these are not exempt fees
quote: does not include tax, title, license, dmv and doc fees, acquisition fees, dealer fees, or first month payment
recommendation: The lease disclaimers state the down payment amount 'does not include...doc fees...dealer fees.' Under Regulation M, the total amount due at lease signing must include ALL amounts due at signing except tax, title, and registration. Doc fees and dealer fees are part of the total due at signing and cannot be excluded. The total due-at-signing figure must include these fees.

title: CPO/certified page titled 'New Jeep SUVs for Sale' — used vehicles mislabeled as new
quote: PAGE TITLE MISMATCH: URL is /inventory/used/certified/ but title says 'New Jeep SUVs for Sale'
recommendation: The certified pre-owned inventory page at /inventory/used/certified/ has the page title 'New Jeep SUVs for Sale.' This directly violates VC §11713(d) which prohibits advertising a used vehicle as new. Certified pre-owned vehicles are legally used vehicles and must not be described as 'new.' Correct the page title to accurately reflect that these are certified pre-owned (used) vehicles, e.g., 'Certified Pre-Owned Vehicles for Sale.'

title: CPO page missing certified pre-owned labeling and program details
quote: has_cpo_label: false — 'certified pre-owned' text NOT found on page. Appears the CPO page may be misconfigured or showing wrong content.
recommendation: The certified pre-owned inventory page does not display 'certified pre-owned' text, and appears to be misconfigured (title says 'New Jeep SUVs'). If vehicles on this page are being sold as certified, they must clearly identify the certification program, and each vehicle must meet certification program requirements per VC §11713.18. Review and fix the CPO page configuration to properly display CPO labeling, program details, and ensure no disqualifying conditions exist for listed vehicles.

title: Price accuracy disclaimer attempts to disclaim responsibility for pricing errors
quote: We will make our best efforts that posted prices are always accurate however, we are not responsible for any typographical or other errors that may appear on the site.
recommendation: This disclaimer attempts to excuse the dealer from honoring advertised prices by attributing errors to typographical mistakes. Under 13 CCR §260.04(b), a specific vehicle advertised at a specific price must be sold at or below that price while it remains unsold, unless the ad states prices are valid only for a specific time period. A blanket disclaimer that the dealer is 'not responsible for any typographical or other errors' may not override this obligation. Remove or revise the disclaimer to comply with CA advertising law. Consider adding expiration dates to pricing instead.

title: Specials page disclaims actual selling price — 'estimated selling price for informational purposes only'
quote: The estimated selling price that appears after calculating dealer offers is for informational purposes, only. You may not qualify for the offers, incentives, discounts, or financing.
recommendation: The specials page shows vehicle prices but then disclaims them as 'estimated' and 'for informational purposes only.' Under VC §11713.1(e), if a price is advertised, it must be the total selling price. Showing a price and then disclaiming it as merely informational creates ambiguity about what the actual selling price is. If the vehicle is being offered at a specific price, state it clearly. If the price depends on qualifications, disclose those qualifications prominently rather than disclaiming the price entirely.

title: VDP states pricing 'includes all offers and incentives' without disclosing specific incentive qualifications
quote: New vehicle pricing includes all offers and incentives. Tax, Title, License, $85 doc fee, $30 electronic filing fee are additional.
recommendation: The VDP disclaimer states pricing 'includes all offers and incentives' but does not itemize which incentives are included or what qualifications are required (e.g., loyalty, military, college grad, financing with manufacturer). If the advertised price includes conditional incentives, each incentive amount and its qualification requirements must be clearly disclosed. Itemize all incentives deducted from the price and their respective qualification criteria.

title: VDP shows finance payment estimate without full Reg Z disclosures
quote: Estimated Finance terms, it is not a Sale Price Offer and is for Comparative Purposes only
recommendation: The VDP appears to show finance payment estimates, which constitute credit trigger terms under Regulation Z. Even if labeled as 'estimated' and 'for comparative purposes only,' displaying a monthly payment amount triggers the requirement for full Reg Z disclosure: (1) amount or percentage of down payment, (2) terms of repayment (number of payments), (3) APR, and (4) whether the APR may increase. Verify that all Reg Z required terms are fully disclosed alongside any finance payment estimate, or remove the payment estimates entirely.

title: VDP shows lease payment estimate without full Reg M disclosures
quote: Estimated Lease Terms, Not an Offer and is for Comparative Purposes Only: Closed-end Lease with estimated terms. Lease payment: $552/Month for 36 Months, $5,230 Due at Signing
recommendation: The VDP displays a lease payment of $552/month with $5,230 due at signing — these are lease trigger terms requiring full Reg M disclosures. Even if labeled as 'estimated' and 'not an offer,' displaying a specific monthly lease payment and due-at-signing amount triggers Regulation M requirements. Verify that all Reg M disclosures are present: total due at signing (broken down), MSRP/capitalized cost, total of payments, mileage limit and excess mileage charge, purchase option, and 'plus tax and license' statement. If disclosures are insufficient, either add full Reg M terms or remove the payment estimates.

title: Used vehicle pricing hidden behind lead capture form contradicts 'Transparent Honest Pricing' claim
quote: Tagline: 'No Hidden Charges. Transparent. Honest Pricing' — but actual price is hidden behind CTA. 'Get Your NO BS Price' requires user interaction (lead capture form) to see actual price.
recommendation: The used vehicle pages claim 'No Hidden Charges. Transparent. Honest Pricing' while simultaneously hiding the actual dealer selling price behind a lead capture form. This creates a contradiction — advertising transparency while practicing the opposite. While hiding prices behind forms is not per se illegal, the juxtaposition with claims of transparency could constitute misleading advertising under B&P Code §17500. Either display actual dealer selling prices openly or remove the transparency/honesty claims.

title: Specials page disclaims vehicle image accuracy
quote: Images, prices, and options shown, including vehicle color, trim, options, pricing and other specifications are subject to availability, incentive offerings, and current pricing and may not reflect the exact vehicle displayed.
recommendation: The specials page disclaims that images 'may not reflect the exact vehicle displayed.' Under VC §11713(s), pictures used in connection with a price advertisement must be of the year, make, and model being offered and shall not depict optional equipment not included at the advertised price. While using stock photos of the correct make/model/year is generally acceptable, this broad disclaimer suggests images may show different trim levels or optional equipment. Ensure all vehicle images match the year, make, model, and trim level of the vehicle being advertised, and remove or narrow this disclaimer.

title: Specials page disclaimer text uses hedging language — 'Consult your dealer for actual price'
quote: Pricing and availability may vary based on a variety of factors, including options, dealer, specials, fees, and financing qualifications. Consult your dealer for actual price and complete details.
recommendation: The disclaimer directs consumers to 'consult your dealer for actual price,' which undermines the requirement that the advertised price IS the actual price. California law requires the advertised price to be the total selling price — not an estimate requiring further consultation. While this phrasing may be a website platform default, it creates the impression that the advertised price is not reliable. Remove language suggesting the advertised price is not the actual price.

title: Specials page lacks explicit start/end dates for special pricing
quote: Page shows vehicle inventory with specials pricing. No expiration dates visible on specials page listings.
recommendation: The specials page advertises special pricing on vehicles but does not display clear start and end dates for the special pricing period. Under B&P Code §17501, 'sale' pricing implies a reduction from regular price and should have defined dates. Add expiration dates to all special pricing offers on this page.

title: Used vehicle listings lack VIN visibility on listing cards
quote: Has used label, has mileage, has VIN and stock number
recommendation: While the crawl data indicates VIN and stock numbers are present on individual vehicle records, verify that the VIN or stock number is clearly visible on each listing card where a price is displayed. When advertising a specific vehicle at a specific price, the vehicle must be identified by VIN (distinguishing portion) or stock number. This is an advisory to verify VIN visibility across all listing views.
